summary: Implemented parse_response, parse_message_list and parse_fetch_response in imapclient/response_parser.py on a token-list parser (quoted strings, NIL, ints, literals, nested tuples, BodyData bodies, Envelope/Address conversion, MODSEQ handling). Against the real test file, 55/55 response parser tests pass when the package __init__ is stubbed; the last full-suite run via c0-test could not collect because imapclient.py (another builder's file) still has a stub require_capability decorator, so 0 tests ran (13 collection errors).
